dryRun: Dry-run: validated input and checked board tokens with providers (no database connection or writes).
dryRunSummary: {companies} company upserts; {sources} source upserts. Existing/new status and database ownership conflicts are not checked without a database connection.
emptyDataset: Dataset is empty; nothing to seed.
seedComplete: Completed {companies} company upserts and {sources} source upserts.
seedFailed: Seed failed. Check dataset identities, database access and unique indexes.
mongodbUriRequired: MONGODB_URI is required. Set it in your environment, .env.development or .env.
providerRequired: Provider must be configured in config/providers.json
invalidHomepage: Use an HTTPS company homepage with a public DNS hostname and no credentials, port, query or fragment
invalidBoardBaseUrl: Board base URLs must use HTTPS, end in / and contain no credentials, query or fragment
dnsFailed: MongoDB DNS lookup failed. Check the Atlas hostname and your DNS resolver or VPN. Set DNS_SERVERS to a working resolver in .env.development, or use Atlas's generated standard connection string.
invalidDnsServers: DNS_SERVERS must contain comma-separated DNS resolver IP addresses.
authenticationFailed: MongoDB authentication failed. Check database username, password encoding and authSource.
authorizationFailed: MongoDB permission denied. Check the database user's write and index permissions.
uniqueConflict: A unique index conflict occurred. Check existing domain and provider/board-token identities and source ownership.
connectionFailed: Cannot reach MongoDB. Check Atlas network access, cluster availability, DNS and the connection hostname.
invalidMongoUri: Invalid MongoDB connection settings. Check MONGODB_URI syntax and percent-encode special characters in credentials.
invalidJson: A JSON file is malformed. Check dataset and configuration JSON syntax.
validationFailed: Dataset, configuration or model validation failed. Run dry-run and check the input fields.
invalidVerificationUrl: Verification URLs must use HTTPS, have no credentials and contain exactly one {boardToken} placeholder outside the hostname.
verificationNotConfigured: Provider verification is not configured in config/board-verification.json.
verificationHttpError: Provider returned HTTP {status}. Check the token; rate limits and provider outages can also prevent verification.
verificationInvalidResponse: Provider did not return the expected JSON response. Token verification failed.
verificationInconclusive: Provider returned no postings. Token validity is inconclusive; seeding stopped rather than assuming it is valid.
verificationResponseTooLarge: Provider response exceeded the configured size limit. Verification stopped.
verificationRequestFailed: Provider network request failed. Check internet access, VPN, proxy and provider availability.
verificationTimedOut: Provider request timed out after {timeoutMs} ms.
verificationRedirected: Provider redirected the verification request (HTTP {status}); check the configured endpoint.
discoveryApiKeyRequired: Set the API key for LLM_PROVIDER: GEMINI_API_KEY for gemini, OPENAI_API_KEY for openai.
discoveryModelRequired: Set GEMINI_MODEL or OPENAI_MODEL for the selected LLM_PROVIDER to a model supporting web search and structured output in separate requests.
discoveryLocalUsage: Usage: npm run discover:companies -- [batchSize]. Set LLM_PROVIDER and its API key/model in .env.development. Local discovery never writes to MongoDB.
openaiRequestFailed: OpenAI request failed before a usable response was received. Check API access and connectivity.
openaiAccessDenied: OpenAI denied access. Check OPENAI_API_KEY, API restrictions, project permissions and regional availability.
openaiQuotaExceeded: OpenAI quota or rate limit exceeded. Check the project's quota, billing and model limits before retrying.
openaiModelUnavailable: Configured OPENAI_MODEL is unavailable for this API key or API version. Check the model ID and account access.
openaiInvalidRequest: OpenAI rejected the request. Check API key validity and whether the configured model supports this stage's OpenAI web search or JSON output settings.
openaiServiceUnavailable: OpenAI returned a server error after bounded retries. Try again later.
openaiTimeout: OpenAI request timed out. Check connectivity or increase DISCOVERY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS within the execution budget.
openaiNetworkFailed: Cannot reach OpenAI. Check DNS, internet access, TLS, VPN and proxy settings.
geminiRequestFailed: Gemini request failed before a usable response was received. Check API access and connectivity.
geminiAccessDenied: Gemini denied access. Check GEMINI_API_KEY, API restrictions, project permissions and regional availability.
geminiQuotaExceeded: Gemini quota or rate limit exceeded. Check project quota, billing and model limits before retrying.
geminiModelUnavailable: Configured GEMINI_MODEL is unavailable for this API key or API version. Check model ID and account access.
geminiInvalidRequest: Gemini rejected the request. Check API key validity and whether GEMINI_MODEL supports this stage's search or JSON output settings.
geminiServiceUnavailable: Gemini returned a server error after bounded retries. Try again later.
geminiTimeout: Gemini request timed out. Check connectivity or increase DISCOVERY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS within the execution budget.
geminiNetworkFailed: Cannot reach Gemini. Check DNS, internet access, TLS, VPN and proxy settings.
geminiApiKeyInvalid: Google rejected GEMINI_API_KEY as invalid or expired. Replace it with a valid Gemini API key from Google AI Studio; an OpenAI API key will not work. Shell variables take precedence over .env.development.
geminiServiceDisabled: Enable the Generative Language API for the Google project associated with GEMINI_API_KEY.
geminiBillingRequired: Google requires billing or a paid plan for this request. Check the selected Gemini project's billing and feature eligibility.
geminiPaymentRequired: Google returned HTTP 402 Payment Required. Check the selected project's payment status or prepaid balance. Repeating the request will not resolve payment restrictions; use an eligible free-tier configuration or the manual verified dataset workflow.
geminiRegionUnsupported: Google reports that this request's region is unsupported. Check your account region and network routing.
geminiApiVersionUnsupported: Google Search requires the v1beta API for this request. Set GEMINI_API_VERSION=v1beta or use the configured default.
ingestionUsage: Usage: npm run ingest:jobs -- [--dry-run|--write]. The default is dry-run.
ingestionWritesDisabled: Set INGESTION_ALLOW_WRITES=true and pass --write only after approving ingestion writes.
ingestionSetupFailed: Job ingestion could not initialize. Check configuration, MongoDB connectivity, permissions and index compatibility.
